name: Non-Inclusive Identity Options
description: Users express frustration over rigid binary gender choices, lack of non-binary or custom pronoun settings, and heteronormative or body-shaming assumptions in readings.

name: Deceptive Subscriptions and Billing
description: Users report being unexpectedly charged for recurring subscriptions, full annual fees, or hidden web charges immediately after signing up for trials or one-time reports.

name: Unhelpful Support and Refunds
description: Users complain that customer service is unreachable, relies on automated bots, refuses valid refund requests, and closes support tickets without resolving issues.

name: Excessive Paywalls and Feature-Locking
description: Users criticize the app for placing basic astrology data, birth charts, and previously free features behind expensive ongoing subscription fees.

name: Predatory Per-Minute Psychic Billing
description: Users report that live psychic and advisor chats are overpriced and feature slow-responding readers or timers that quickly drain purchased credits.

name: Intrusive In-App Advertisements
description: Users complain about constant pop-up ads and aggressive promotion of paid services that repeatedly interrupt basic app navigation and chart viewing.

name: Technical Glitches and Bugs
description: Users experience app-breaking bugs including login failures, frozen loading screens, broken widgets, audio glitches during calls, and age-selection errors.

name: Recycled and Low-Quality Content
description: Users highlight poorly written, generic, or outdated horoscopes that contain obvious typos, contradictory advice, or recycled text from previous months and years.
